name: RoCoLe: A Robusta Coffee Leaf Images Dataset for Plant Diseases Recognition
description: RoCoLe is an agricultural benchmark dataset containing 1,560 images of Robusta coffee leaves (Coffea canephora) captured in active agricultural plantations in Ecuador. The dataset includes healthy leaves and leaves exhibiting visible manifestations of red spider mites and coffee leaf rust (Hemileia vastatrix). Photographed under uncontrolled outdoor lighting conditions, each sample includes image-level diagnostic annotations regarding overall leaf health (healthy vs. diseased) and precise disease severity ratings reflecting the percentage of leaf area affected by lesions. RoCoLe enables rigorous evaluation of machine learning methods for disease detection, severity estimation, and mobile automated phenotyping.
